classes.full_desktop_journey: Driven end to end through visible controls (semantic Tk and, locally, real Win32 input) against the real GUI, compiler, NJR, JobService, queue, runner and History. Backends are loopback fakes unless a physical run says otherwise.
classes.partial_journey: Some steps of the workflow are exercised through visible controls inside another journey, but the workflow is not driven end to end.
classes.integration_only: Covered by tests below the desktop (controller, service, headless widget or journey-harness tests); no real-input desktop journey.
classes.untested: No automated coverage identified for the workflow at this version.

physical_gpu_note: No row claims physical GPU coverage. Physical execution is a separate gated mode and is NOT RUN for this version.
